title.value: An Act to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
title.provenance: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

location.provenance: The People of the State of New York, represented in Senate and Assembly, do enact as follows:

pfas_definition.provenance: "Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances" or "PFAS substances" means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: After December thirty-first, two thousand twenty-six, no person this state anti-fogging sprays or wipes polyfluoroalkyl substances as intentionally added chemicals or that contain perfluoroalkyl and alkyl substances at or above a level that the department shall establish in regulation.
